items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: My name was Herb, Walter Nelson, and we had one of Lawrence's other cousins that played piano.

ctx.x: When you played with Herb Moran, who did you say was in that band now?
My name was Herb, Walter Nelson, and we had one of Lawrence's other cousins that played piano. I can't recall his name either.
Oh, is he related to Saeed? Yeah.
